promptStyle: Photorealistic Vietnamese fashion e-commerce catalog photography, square 1:1, warm off-white seamless studio background, soft natural lighting, realistic fabric texture, centered composition, no text, no logo, no watermark, no props or extra products.
peopleRule: NAM uses a young adult Vietnamese male model; NU uses a young adult Vietnamese female model; underwear and accessories are product-only with no person or body.
